title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
description: Named and defined the RAG paradigm. Retriever + generator end-to-end. Open-domain QA with parametric + non-parametric memory. Every enterprise RAG system traces to this paper.
authors: Lewis, Perez, Piktus, Petroni, Karpukhin, Goyal, Küttler, Lewis, Yih, Rocktäschel, Riedel, Kiela
